theorem: With prime cutoff P and even-oscillator cutoff K=floor(log P), sum_{p<=P}1/p minus sum_{k<K}1/(k+1/4) converges to B1+psi(1/4).
source_reason: Prime locations are u=log p and the gamma determinant fixes oscillator levels k+1/4, selecting the shared logarithmic cutoff scale.
scale_falsifier: K=floor(c log P) shifts the finite part by minus log(c); c must be fixed by source units rather than fitted to Xi.
positivity_warning: The cancellation is a relative difference of positive divergent traces, not a positive covariance.
open_target: Construct one relative block determinant retaining both the finite covariance subtraction and T-dependent off-diagonal arithmetic phase.
status: canonical leading divergence cancellation; full relative determinant unavailable
